description: This file defines the SchedulerTriggerListener class, which implements Quartz's TriggerListener interface to handle trigger events in a scheduling system. It manages tenant context switching and veto logic during job execution.

classes.name: SchedulerTriggerListener
classes.description: Implements Quartz's TriggerListener to handle trigger events, manage tenant context, and determine job execution vetoing.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the trigger listener.

methods.name: triggerFired
methods.description: Logs when a trigger is fired.

methods.name: vetoJobExecution
methods.description: Determines whether to veto job execution based on tenant context and external veto logic.

methods.name: triggerComplete
methods.description: Logs when a trigger completes execution.
